papers.title: Naive Visual Memory is Not Enough: A Failure-Mode Study of GUI Agents
papers.authors: Seoyoung Choi, Minseok Ko, Hyunseok Lee, Kunwoong Kim, Woomin Song, Chanseok Jeon, Jinwoo Shin
papers.affiliations: Seoul National University, POSTECH, KAIST, Pion Corporation
papers.intro: 本文提出一种GUI agent失败模式分类法，实证发现全图视觉记忆存在“分叉效应”（减少状态级错误但放大动作级错误），并设计了行动接地视觉记忆（AGMem）框架，通过存储与动作相关的局部截图区域来显著提升任务成功率。

papers.title: Temporal Backtracking Search for Test-time Generative Video Reasoning
papers.authors: Sejoon Jun, Zheng Ding, Huangyuan Su, Weirui Ye, Yilun Du
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, video search
papers.affiliations: Northeastern University, Independent Researcher, Harvard & Kempner, MIT
papers.intro: 本文提出时间回溯搜索（Temporal Backtracking Search, TBS），将视频生成的测试时搜索空间从去噪轴转移到时间轴，通过生成-验证-重启的迭代循环，利用已验证的前缀锚点进行分支修复，从而显著提升视频模型的长时程推理能力。

papers.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Generation
papers.authors: Dian Zheng, Harry Lee, Manyuan Zhang, Kaituo Feng, Zoey Guo, Ray Zhang, Hongsheng Li
papers.affiliations: CUHK MMLab（Dian Zheng, Kaituo Feng, Ray Zhang, Hongsheng Li）; Meituan（Dian Zheng, Harry Lee, Manyuan Zhang）; CUHK IMIXR（Zoey Guo）
papers.intro: InterleaveThinker是首个通过规划器-生成器-评论家多智能体管道赋予任意冻结图像生成器强交错生成能力的框架，利用专用数据集和单步强化学习（GRPO）实现长程生成轨迹的逐步校正，在交错生成和推理基准上均达到显著提升。

papers.title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation
papers.authors: Bardienus Pieter Duisterhof, Deva Ramanan, Jeffrey Ichnowski, Justin Johnson, Keunhong Park
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University; World Labs
papers.intro: Modality Forcing是一种简单、可扩展的后训练方案，通过为RGB和深度模态分配独立噪声水平，使单个DiT模型支持联合图像-深度生成、单向条件生成，且仅需稀疏深度数据训练，同时证明深度预测精度随T2I模型和数据规模提升而改善。

papers.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
papers.authors: Junke Wang, Qihang Zhang, Shuai Yang, Yiming Luo, Yujun Shen, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Yinghao Xu
papers.affiliations: Institute of Trustworthy Embodied AI, Fudan University; Robbyant, Ant Group; Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: RepWAM通过提出一种表示视觉-动作分词器，将视觉潜在变量与冻结的视觉基础模型对齐，并在同一语义空间中诱导出潜在动作令牌，从而构建一个表示导向的世界动作模型，显著提升了真实世界操作任务的成功率和仿真基准性能。

papers.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning
papers.authors: Seokju Cho, Ryo Hachiuma, Abhishek Badki, Hang Su, Byung-Kwan Lee, Chan Hee Song, Sifei Liu, Subhashree Radhakrishnan, Seungryong Kim, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Min-Hung Chen
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA（主要机构，作者Seokju Cho同时隶属于KAIST，标注为实习期间在NVIDIA工作）
papers.intro: 本文提出SpatialClaw，一个无需训练的空间推理框架，通过将代码作为动作接口（code as action interface），让VLM在持久化Python内核中逐步编写、执行和修正代码，灵活组合感知工具与数值计算库，显著提升开放式3D/4D空间推理能力。

papers.title: Flex4DHuman: Flexible Multi-view Video Diffusion for 4D Human Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jen-Hao Cheng, Yipeng Wang, Hao Zhang, Gengshan Yang, Jenq-Neng Hwang
papers.affiliations: University of Washington, World Labs
papers.intro: Flex4DHuman是一个基于扩散模型的多视角视频生成框架，它通过五轴位置编码（融合时空、视图索引和连续SE(3)相机几何）实现从单目或稀疏多视角视频到密集多视角视频的灵活生成，无需显式几何先验，并可直接用于下游4D高斯泼溅重建。

papers.title: World Tracing: Generative Pixel-Aligned Geometry Beyond the Visible
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Mohamed El Banani, Jen-Hao Cheng, Paul Zhang, Yi Hua, Ben Mildenhall, Christoph Lassner, Narendra Ahuja, Gengshan Yang
papers.affiliations: World Labs, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
papers.intro: 本文提出World Tracing，一种生成式像素对齐多层几何表示，通过为每个输入像素预测一个有序3D点堆栈（第一层为可见表面，后续层为沿射线的遮挡表面），并基于流匹配扩散变压器WT-DiT进行高效建模，从而在单个框架内同时实现忠实的可见表面重建和完整的遮挡几何生成。

papers.title: Revisiting Vehicle Color Recognition in Long-Tailed Surveillance Scenarios
papers.authors: Vinícius Orrú, Bruno H. Foggiatto, Gabriel E. Lima, David Menotti, Rayson Laroca
papers.tags: image classification, image generation, video search
papers.affiliations: Pontifical Catholic University of Paraná (PUCPR), National High Court of Brazil, Federal University of Paraná (UFPR)
papers.intro: 本文针对长尾监控场景下的车辆颜色识别问题，使用两种现成生成模型（文本条件生成和图像条件颜色编辑）合成少数类图像，并系统融合现代视觉表示、损失重加权、颜色安全增强、前景预处理和集成融合等策略，在UFPR-VeSV数据集上将宏准确率提升至79.7%，较此前最佳结果提高8.2个百分点，并提供了详细的错误分…

papers.title: Edit the Bits, Diff the Codes: Bitwise Residual Editing for Visual Autoregressive Models
papers.authors: Shengqiang Zhang, Ruotong Liao, Volker Tresp, Barbara Plank, Hinrich Schütze
papers.affiliations: LMU Munich & Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML)
papers.intro: 本文提出BitResEdit，一种无需训练的bitwise-residual VAR图像编辑器，通过BitEdit在采样前进行Bernoulli-KL信任域源负向引导，并通过ResEdit在采样后以掩码门控的连续代码残差实现定位编辑，在PIE-Bench上取得同类最强文本对齐性能。

papers.title: Measurement-Calibrated Multi-Camera Fusion for Vision-Based Indoor Localization
papers.authors: Mateo Toro Diz, Jonathan Hoss, Noah Klarmann
papers.affiliations: Rosenheim Technical University of Applied Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于测量校准的多相机融合方法，通过逐组件量化单相机局部化误差（单应性、人体检测、运动跟踪）并用于卡尔曼滤波器的测量噪声分配，实验表明与传统融合相比，该方法显著降低轨迹方差并改善运动平滑性，而对绝对精度提升有限。

papers.title: Heterogeneous LiDAR Early Fusion and Learned Re-Ranking Strategy for Robust Long-Term Place Recognition in Unstructured Environments
papers.authors: Judith Vilella-Cantos, Juan José Cabrera, Mónica Ballesta, David Valiente, Luis Payá
papers.affiliations: University Institute for Engineering Research, Miguel Hernández University
papers.intro: 本文提出MinkUNeXt-VINE++方法，通过早期融合两个不同LiDAR传感器（Livox Mid-360和Velodyne VLP-16）的点云数据并引入轻量级学习的重排序策略，在葡萄园等非结构化环境的地点识别任务中取得显著性能提升。

papers.title: Reroute, Don't Remove: Recoverable Visual Token Routing for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Cheng-Yu Yang, Shao-Yuan Lo, Yu-Lun Liu
papers.tags: scene understanding, visual grounding, image captioning, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (Cheng-Yu Yang, Yu-Lun Liu); National Taiwan University (Shao-Yuan Lo)
papers.intro: 提出Reroute，一种无需训练的即插即用方法，将视觉token的不可逆剪枝替换为可恢复路由：被推迟的token不永久删除，而是跳过当前阶段并保留在候选池中，在后续阶段可重新评分和入选，从而在不增加计算预算的前提下显著改善定位性能并维持通用VQA表现。

papers.title: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
papers.authors: Jadelynn Dao, Milan Ganai, Yasmina Abukhadra, Ajay Sridhar, Mozhgan Nasr Azadani, Katie Luo, Clark Barrett, Jiajun Wu, Chelsea Finn, Marco Pavone
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Stanford University, University of Waterloo, NVIDIA
papers.intro: 本文提出DIRECT框架，一个利用多模态场景上下文动态路由测试时计算资源的分配方法，通过为每个任务选择最合适的VLM规划器，显著提升了成功率与计算成本的帕累托前沿。

papers.title: VLGA: Vision-Language-Geometry-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Jin Yao, Dhruva Dixith Kurra, Tom Lampo, Zezhou Cheng, Danhua Guo, Burhan Yaman
papers.tags: autonomous driving, multimodal learning, scene understanding, point cloud
papers.affiliations: Uber AV Labs; University of Virginia
papers.intro: VLGA首次在VLA模型中引入了一个受密集像素级点图重建损失监督的、参数隔离的几何专家，通过四专家混合变换器架构，同时实现了语言推理、密集空间接地和专用几何容量，在开放环路和闭环驾驶任务上均达到了最先进水平。

papers.title: Illumination-Robust Camera-Based Heart-Rate Estimation for Physiological Sensing in Robots
papers.authors: Zhi Wei Xu, Torbjörn E. M. Nordling
papers.tags: pose estimation, vision transformer, medical image
papers.affiliations: National Cheng Kung University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种端到端时空Transformer框架，集成PRNet 3D面部对齐、剪辑级光照增强、残差时间标准化模块和混合时频损失，在静态多光照协议下将心率MAE降至0.79 bpm，相比PhysFormer降低93.6%。

papers.title: A Turbo-Inference Strategy for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation
papers.authors: Zhen Zhao, Gang Zhang, Xiaolin Hu, Liang Tang
papers.tags: object detection, instance segmentation, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: School of Technology, Beijing Forestry University; Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University; Beijing National Research Center for Information Science and Technology, Tsinghua University; Chinese Institute for Brain Research (CIBR)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种无需重新训练模型的涡轮推理策略（Turbo-Inference Strategy），通过引入涡轮检测头（Turbo-Detection Head）和涡轮分割头（Turbo-Segmentation Head），在推理阶段迭代利用检测与分割之间的互补信息，同时提升目标检测和实例分割的精度。

papers.title: DepthMaster: Unified Monocular Depth Estimation for Perspective and Panoramic Images
papers.authors: Pengfei Wang, Shihao Wang, Liyi Chen, Zhiyuan Ma, Guowen Zhang, Lei Zhang
papers.tags: depth estimation, scene understanding, vision transformer, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.intro: DepthMaster通过将全景图像分解为重叠的透视补丁、注入虚拟投影相机的几何先验，并引入对应一致性损失（CCL）作为软约束，在不修改标准Transformer架构的前提下统一了透视和全景的度量深度估计，在13个数据集上达到了最先进的零样本性能。

papers.title: Echoes of the Prior: A Computational Phenomenology of Forgetting
papers.authors: Gege Gao, Bernhard Schölkopf, Andreas Geiger
papers.affiliations: Gege Gao - Eberhard Karl University of Tübingen; Bernhard Schölkopf - Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems; Andreas Geiger - Eberhard Karl University of Tübingen, Tübingen AI Center
papers.intro: 本文提出一个名为“Echoes of the Prior”的交互式艺术安装，通过在3D高斯泼溅模型中引入受控的“突触衰减”，模拟记忆/感官流的结构性退化，从而可视化遗忘的主观现象学，并建立神经形态美学的框架。

papers.title: Natural-Language Temporal Grounding in Hour-Long Videos is a Search Problem: A Benchmark and Empirical Decomposition
papers.authors: Sukmin Seo, Geewook Kim
papers.tags: video search, multimodal learning, CLIP, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: NAVER Cloud AI；KAIST AI
papers.intro: 本文发布首个开放的小时级自然语言时间定位基准ExtremeWhenBench（2,273个查询/194个视频，平均75.7分钟），并通过实证分解证明小时级时间定位的瓶颈是搜索而非识别——所有开放Video-LLM在小时级视频上性能崩塌，而帧级检索基线反而超越它们，85%的失败归因于搜索失败，retr…
